deathSays.line: 📖 LEARNED: Ritual & Meaning (Level 1). Marking the dead matters. Even without religion, ritual holds grief.
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"

🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~1504 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
Denise exhales. "It's dead? It's really dead."

One mouse is a snack. Fifty mice is a meal. Do the math. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.

"Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Raj says "Did it look at you? Before?" Owen breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A person, maybe 30s speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
Raj: "Wild Onion is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
It is holding a meeting. About you.
"PICKET LINE!" A ducks in a row lumbers in, holding a tiny sign. (The rep called backup — from the OLD wave.)
"Brothers, sisters, monsters — gather round." It is holding a meeting. About you.
With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🗣️ Svyatoslav to Manaaki, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

The little star inside Denise goes quiet — and wakes up inside Roberto. Denise never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Roberto will never be hungry again while it hums, and Denise is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
